notes: FIXTURE: plugin-tool-fixture.ts folded into plugin-fixture.ts; seedPluginStore keeps its signature and plugin id (dev.example.acme-adapter). The seeded acme plugin now serves a real runnable tool: inspect declares executables [{name: acme-demo, path: bin/acme-demo, interpreter: native}] and fetch-artifact-record publishes the true sha256/size of ACME_TOOL_TAR (a 0755 #!/bin/sh tool) with a location on the record endpoint's origin; acmeToolFetch() is the exported fixture-transport stand-in for the host-side download. The stale 'cannot carry tool bytes / fails closed at digest verification' comment is replaced with the honesty invariant (plugin is metadata authority; host fetches from the published location and digest-verifies). E2E PROVEN (bwrap-enforced): opmx --plugin acme demo resolves through the real plugin over stdio, host-fetches, digest-verifies, materializes, and runs — exit 0, stdout 'acme-demo-ran'. Tamper case (same-length bytes, flipped byte) fails closed exit 7 'digest mismatch', nothing executes. PROJECT-LEVEL PATH: PARTIALLY PROVEN, RUN STEP GAPPED. `opm add pkg:acme/demo@1.0.0` in a bound project works end to end (exit 0; declared native bin pinned into opm.lock.json, .opm/project.json, and .opm/bin/acme-demo shim — verified in the test). But `opmx acme-demo` fails closed with NOT_FOUND: opmx re-activates the generation before resolving, and activateGeneration (packages/opm-project/src/generations.ts:831) re-derives bins via discoverBins(storePath, ecosystem), which returns [] for plugin ecosystems — GenerationMember carries no bins, so lock-pinned declared bins do not survive activation. Layer 03 defect, reported not patched (runtime code outside layer 04 scope). Fix direction: record bins on GenerationMember at recordGeneration time and prefer them in activateGeneration over disk discovery. SECOND DEFECT (pre-existing since a1759a5, not layer 01–03): the ephemeral cache never hits — fetchTool always passes bytes to materializeLockPackage, so the store archive is never consulted, a repeat opmx run re-downloads and re-verifies, and opmx's '(cached)' line is unreachable (test asserts fetches===2 to document current behavior). Help text and guide claimed 'a repeat run downloads nothing'; both corrected to the honest wording in this layer rather than left stale. DOCS: guide plugin section gained the working loop (add → opmx --plugin → verification semantics); opmx help states the host downloads/verifies plugin-published bytes. Stale-claim sweep: living docs (guides, ADR 0040, spec delegated-adapter.md §Artifact bytes/§Executables) are accurate as layer 01 wrote them; the 'resolve but refuse execution' claims remaining in docs/plans/opm-plugins/sdlc-state.md and docs/plans/dispatch-log.md are dated historical records of the closed initiative and were deliberately left untouched. EXAMPLES: no plugin example tree exists; added a pointer note in examples/opm-project/README.md to the guide's plugin section rather than building a new example.
deviations: Two scope items resolved as report-instead-of-patch per the layer brief: (1) 'repeat run hits the cache / (cached)' — unreachable by construction in ephemeral.ts (pre-existing), documented by assertion and corrected docs instead of a runtime fix; (2) project-level opmx run — gapped by the activateGeneration bin re-discovery defect in layer 03's plumbing, proven up to add/install and reported with a fix direction. Tiny test-only addition beyond the letter of the scope: the bound-project test amends project.ecosystems in opm.toml to allowlist 'acme' (required by addPackage's ECOSYSTEM_DENIED guard; no production change).
